title: manager_badge_scan
beats: I got written up for scanning a badge.
Not stealing. Not clocking someone out. Scanning a badge to fix a $2 price error.
I'm 19M, working register at a sunglasses kiosk, nothing crazy.
Customer points out his sunglasses ring up $8.99 but the sticker says $6.99.
I can't fix prices myself, only a manager badge can override it.
So I go get my supervisor, she's 24F, been there longer than me.
She stares at the screen for a solid 20 seconds, then whispers to me, 'I don't know how to do it.'
I whisper back, 'I can-' but she cuts me off before I finish.
She tells the customer he has to pay full price. He is NOT having it.
Voice raising, line building up behind him, she's frozen.
I ask her to just scan her badge so I can do it myself.
She does. I fix it in ten seconds. Customer leaves happy.
Then she pulls me aside in front of everyone.
Says I made her look 'stupid' in front of a customer.
I said, 'You didn't know how to do it, so I did. What's the big deal?'
She says I threw her under the bus to make myself look good.
I said, 'I'm selfish for doing your job that you couldn't?'
She just walked away. Didn't say another word.
I keep replaying that last line in my head.
Was I actually the bad guy here, or was she just embarrassed I was right?
